About ShelterDayOut

ShelterDayOut is a free directory of animal shelter programs that let people take dogs out for the day, host a sleepover, or spend time with shelter cats.

Studies of these programs find that outings help dogs get adopted, and they're good for people too. But every shelter runs its program differently, with its own sign-up page, and they're hard to find. ShelterDayOut gathers them in one place.

How we keep it accurate

We build listings from shelters' own public pages and check every listing each month. Each listing shows when it was last checked and whether it's open to the public, volunteers only, or unconfirmed. Shelters can claim their listing to keep it current.

What we don't do

We don't run outings, take bookings or handle payments. Shelters decide who can take an animal out and set their own rules and agreements. When you send an outing request, we email it to the shelter so they can reply to you directly.
